name: Layered Waves
description: Layers of slow translucent waves filling the lower part of the frame, deepening where they overlap.

props.name: colors
props.description: Band colours from the back wave to the front one, cycled if there are more waves. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: waveCount
props.description: Number of wave bands, from 1 to 8.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: Height of the front wave above and below its rest line, in pixels. Bands further back are lower.

props.name: speed
props.description: `slow`, `fast`, or a multiplier where `slow` is 1 and `fast` is 2.5.

props.name: blur
props.description: Softness of the filled bands, in pixels. The crest lines stay sharp.

props.name: variant
props.description: `filled` draws translucent bands with a line along each crest; `lines` draws the crest lines only.

props.name: level
props.description: Where the water line sits, from 0 (top) to 1 (bottom). The bands spread out below it.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the waves. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the waves. Keep it above the water line.
